description_html:
Former Biden administration AI advisors Ben Buchanan and Tantum Collins join Nathan to discuss their book, The Bitter Struggle, and their experience shaping U.S. policy on compute supply chains and export controls. Drawing on their backgrounds in government and DeepMind, they unpack the geopolitical strategy of building an allied compute lead over China in order to spend that advantage on safety. The conversation probes the clash between frontier lab idealism and national security, bilateral talks over AI risks in nuclear command, and persistent technical hurdles like reward hacking.

For full show notes, links, and references, read the episode page:https://www.cognitiverevolution.ai/spend-the-lead-on-safety-biden-ai-advisors-ben-buchanan-tantum-collins-on-the-fate-of-the-world/
